text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 · SETUP; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; PRIVATE BONDS; WON OR LOST
sees: Two circles joined by a horizontal line with a small orange dot in the middle, on an orange sunburst background. Left circle labeled PRIVATE BONDS, right labeled WON OR LOST.
message: Private bonds are what decide whether the battle is won or lost.
wouldConfuse: Relationship between the two labels is unclear; a slider-like dot suggests a spectrum.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 · CONSEQUENCE; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; CONFESSING THEIR SHAMEFUL SIN
sees: A cartoon man in a dark suit and tie with closed eyes, furrowed brows and a frown, head bowed. Large text beside him on a pale sunburst background.
message: People are confessing their shameful sin and feeling remorse.

text: INSIGHT 02 / 08 · SETUP; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; HER HEARTBEAT, NOT THE REALM (REALM highlighted)
sees: A cartoon figure in dark armor with horn-like hair spikes, worried face, pointing an arm to the side. Grey background with a pale circle.
message: She cares about a person's heartbeat, not about ruling the realm.
wouldConfuse: Figure points at empty space; unclear who 'her' is.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 · TURN; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; REDEFINES WHAT LOYALTY MEANS
sees: Two cartoon characters side by side: a dark-haired armored one smiling and pointing, and a blond one in brown with a flat, uneasy face. Grey sunburst background.
message: This moment redefines what loyalty means between the characters.
wouldConfuse: Smile versus uneasy expression leaves the tone ambiguous.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 · DEVELOPMENT; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; BURNING THOSE THRONES
sees: An angry cartoon man in a dark suit pointing at a large orange flame. Grey striped background.
message: He is setting the thrones on fire, burning down the seats of power.
wouldConfuse: No throne is shown, only a flame.

text: INSIGHT 06 / 08 · CONSEQUENCE; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; THE HORROR WASHES OVER HER
sees: A giant solid black head silhouette with horn-like spikes on the left, and a cartoon character in dark armor on the right with wide eyes and a flat mouth. Warm sunburst background with small grey dots.
message: Horror washes over her as she realizes what happened.
wouldConfuse: The black silhouette is unexplained and could be read as a shadow or villain; the face looks blank rather than horrified.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 · DEVELOPMENT; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; SUPPLY LINES; STEEL; RATIONS; FUNDED BATTALIONS
sees: Four empty containers, each with three orange dots at the bottom, labeled with war resources. Grey background with a pale circle.
message: The army depends on supply lines, steel, rations and funded battalions.
wouldConfuse: Dots look the same in each container so quantity or meaning is unclear; containers look empty.

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 · DEVELOPMENT; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; THEIR AUTONOMY (struck through with orange line)
sees: Two cartoon characters, one blond and sad, one dark-haired in armor, standing close together next to a chain with one orange link among navy links. Title text is crossed out.
message: Their autonomy is taken away; they are bound and controlled.
wouldConfuse: Orange link meaning unclear; the chain is not attached to the characters.

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 · DEVELOPMENT; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; BURN THE PROGENY LAWS
sees: A cartoon man in a dark suit with arms raised and open mouth next to a big orange flame. Grey striped background.
message: He is calling to burn the progeny laws.
wouldConfuse: Raised arms could read as celebration or alarm.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 · CLOSE; BURN OF THE EVERFLAME; BREATHTAKINGLY RECKLESS (RECKLESS highlighted)
sees: An angry cartoon character in dark armor with furrowed brows and a frown, with a small orange shield with a cross at the bottom. Beige sunburst background.
message: The ending verdict is that the act was breathtakingly reckless.
wouldConfuse: The small shield icon is cropped and its meaning is unclear.
